overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: omitting a separate "open session" entry from the June 29 notice was permissible, and the executive session subtopics were sufficiently detailed. The matter was closed.

allegations.summary: The June 29 meeting notice did not list 'open session' as a distinct topic before the executive session.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board likewise did not violate the Open Meeting Law by omitting "Open Session" from this notice.

allegations.summary: The executive session topics in the June 29 notice (labor settlements, workers' compensation settlement, wind turbine litigation) were insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board's decisions regarding the level of information to include in the executive topic were reasonable, and therefore find that the executive session topic was sufficiently detailed to inform members of the public of the subjects to be discussed the June 29 meeting.
